title: Math & Coordinates
explanation: Java does arithmetic with + - * / and %. One catch: dividing two whole numbers throws the remainder away, so 37 / 16 is 2, not 2.3.
That is exactly how you snap to a chunk boundary, and % hands you the leftover - how far into the chunk you are standing.
playerX, playerY and playerZ report where you are right now. Remember that blocks you place are offsets from you, not absolute world coordinates.
